summary: File your 2025 federal tax return online.

micro_tasks.title: Gather W-2 and 1099 forms
micro_tasks.description: Collect every W-2 and 1099 into one folder.

acceptance_criteria.text: All W-2s and 1099s are in one folder

micro_tasks.title: Choose and sign in to tax software
micro_tasks.description: Pick a tax tool and create or log in to your account.

acceptance_criteria.text: Signed in to a tax tool

micro_tasks.title: Enter your income details
micro_tasks.description: Type the figures from each W-2 and 1099 into the tool.

acceptance_criteria.text: Total income entered matches your forms

micro_tasks.title: Enter your deductions
micro_tasks.description: Add standard or itemized deductions you qualify for.

micro_tasks.title: Review the full return
micro_tasks.description: Read each section and check for errors before filing.

micro_tasks.title: Find last year's AGI
micro_tasks.description: Locate your 2024 Adjusted Gross Income to verify identity.

micro_tasks.title: Submit the return
micro_tasks.description: E-file the return and capture the confirmation link.

micro_tasks.title: Save the filed confirmation
micro_tasks.description: Download and store a copy of the filed return.

acceptance_criteria.text: Saved a copy of the filed return
